name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  test:
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v2.0.0
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v4.0.0
        with:
          just-version: 1.58.0
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.9.3
      - name: Install tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2.88.1
        with:
          tool: nextest,cargo-llvm-cov
      - name: Configure RUSTFLAGS for Windows
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "RUSTFLAGS=${RUSTFLAGS} -C link-args=/STACK:8388608" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Run tests
        run: just test-mq test-doc test-all-features test
        env:
          NEXTEST_RETRIES: 3
      - name: Generate code coverage
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: cargo llvm-cov --all-features --workspace --lcov --output-path lcov.info
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7.1.1
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        with:
          files: lcov.info
          fail_ci_if_error: true

  format-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v2.0.0
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v4.0.0
        with:
          just-version: 1.58.0
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.9.3
      - name: Run format check
        run: just fmt

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v2.0.0
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v4.0.0
        with:
          just-version: 1.58.0
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.9.3
      - name: Run lint
        run: just lint

  check-deny:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action@v2.1.1
        with:
          command: check bans licenses sources

  check-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v4.0.0
        with:
          just-version: 1.58.0
      - uses: harehare/setup-mq@v1.1.6
        with:
          bins: docs
      - name: Check docs
        run: just docs
      - name: Check for diffs in docs
        run: |
          if [[ -n $(git status --porcelain docs/) ]]; then
            echo "Error: Changes detected in docs directory. Please commit these changes."

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
